claim: One cohesive task adds immutable typed task-chain candidates, compact exact-commit implementation results, dependency-aware promotion, and replayable frontier/workspace transitions with an exhaustive minimal successor-state contract and no durable review residue.
evidence: OUT-004 authority and frozen walkthrough Steps 11-13 require one accepted task definition to carry task/outcome/scope identities, applicable commitments, internal dependencies, required outputs, maintained surfaces, constraints/exclusions, acceptance observations, and proof boundaries rather than title-only planner prose.

The task candidate is published idempotently under the active Planning claim without stage movement; matching identity/digest promotion atomically creates immutable task authority and dependency readiness, while duplicate/cyclic/unresolved/no-ready candidates fail with frontier bytes unchanged.

Compact Implementation results retain only stable result identity, admitted authority and promoted task-definition digests, and exact completed commit; Build advance validates workspace HEAD and writer custody, updates last_reviewed_commit, and releases capacity through recoverable existing coordination primitives.

Successor rules are mechanically closed: retry carries a validated abandoned commit only as replay input and stores no prose; planning return retains completed task/result pairs and removes unreviewed authority; design return clears outcome task/result authority; block binds a validated clean resume commit while leaving the reviewed boundary unchanged.

Public proof inspects frontier bytes, Git refs/HEAD, coordination record, and capacity ledger through interruption replay; post-cycle frontier bytes must omit supplied reviewer/model/actor/command/proof/report/timestamp sentinels, preventing residue through both extra and allowed fields.

Source owners are bounded to the isolated v2 delivery runtime, existing workspace coordination participation, revision carry-forward, exports, and focused maintained tests; bootstrap target_runtime.py/work_items.py, adapters, contexts/acquisition, and Integration/package completion are excluded.
